data.description:
## Description

**What**: Build out per-module unit tests using `respx` / `httpx.MockTransport`-style provider mocks (or `pytest-httpx` per S1's transport-verification outcome). Add integration tests covering both Anthropic and OpenAI provider paths end-to-end. Remove the `PATH`-mocked curl harness from existing unit tests. Configure CI install pipeline to use `actions/setup-python` with `cache: 'pip'` against the checked-in lockfile. Capture post-migration p50/p95 CI review-job duration on the fixture corpus, paired with S1's pre-migration baseline for delta calculation.

**Why**: SC5 of the epic. Per-module unit tests replace the whole-script `PATH`-mocked curl harness. Integration tests verify both providers actually work end-to-end. Cached pip install keeps cold-runner install in the seconds-not-minutes range. The duration baseline pairing makes the SC5 "neutral-or-better" assertion measurable.

**Scope**:
- IN: Per-module unit tests (`runner.py`, `classifier.py`, `dispatch.py`, `providers/*`, `findings.py`) using respx/httpx.MockTransport (or pytest-httpx per S1 outcome); integration tests for Anthropic + OpenAI end-to-end; removal of PATH-mocked curl from existing unit tests; CI install pipeline uses actions/setup-python with cache: 'pip' against checked-in lockfile; post-migration p50/p95 duration capture on fixture corpus.
- OUT: Pre-migration duration baseline (S1); golden corpus capture (S1); parity test (S4); contract test for shim (S3).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, every module in `dso_ci_review/` has unit tests using respx/httpx.MockTransport (or pytest-httpx per S1's transport verification). No unit test relies on `PATH`-mocked curl. `pytest --collect-only` count grows; per-test runtime drops compared to the previous whole-script harness.
  ← Satisfies: "Per-module unit tests using respx / httpx.MockTransport-style provider mocks (no PATH-mocked curl in unit tests)"
- When this story is complete, integration tests exercise both Anthropic and OpenAI provider paths end-to-end against fixture diffs.
  ← Satisfies: "Integration tests exercise both Anthropic and OpenAI end-to-end"
- When this story is complete, the CI install pipeline uses `actions/setup-python` (or platform equivalent) with `cache: 'pip'` against a checked-in lockfile so cold-runner pip install does not regress CI run duration.
  ← Satisfies: "CI install pipeline uses actions/setup-python with cache: 'pip' against a checked-in lockfile"
- When this story is complete, post-migration p50 and p95 CI review-job duration on the fixture corpus is measured and paired with S1's pre-migration baseline. The delta is recorded in a checked-in artifact and surfaced for S7's close-artifact report.
  ← Satisfies: "CI run duration neutral-or-better"

## Considerations

- [Performance] CI cached pip install via `actions/setup-python` `cache: 'pip'` against checked-in lockfile is the standard mitigation for cold-install cost. The lockfile must use exact-version pinning (per S2).
- [Testing] Mock library choice (respx vs pytest-httpx) is determined by S1's transport-verification outcome. If S1 detected `aiohttp` on any provider path, all subsequent unit tests in this story use pytest-httpx, not respx.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, per-module unit tests + Anthropic + OpenAI integration tests cover the Python module with cached CI installs and post-migration duration metrics
